name: Alicon Castalloy Ltd
title: Alicon Castalloy Ltd - 531147 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue ₹495 crore (+16% YoY) but gross margin fell to 45% (−248 bps) and PAT ₹24 crore for FY26 vs ₹46 crore; FY27 guided to 8–10% growth ex-aluminium with capex ₹130–150 crore, utilisation ~78%.
